text:
Fixed. Dropped the amplitude != 0.0 filter in Regressor.fromEvents so input event i maps to output event i; evalLoop now skips zero-amplitude events instead, so the saved convolution is still saved.

Writing the test turned up a second live instance of the same broken invariant: Regressor.evaluate windows onsets to [gridStart - span, gridEnd] via keepIdx, then evalLoop looked up per-event HRFs by the COMPACTED index. Any windowed-out onset re-bound every survivor to the wrong kernel. Reproduced at full amplitude (max diff 1.0) before the fix. Original event indices are now threaded through evalLoop explicitly.

Tests: RegressorSuite 'retains zero-amplitude events so event indices stay stable' and 'a zero-amplitude event occupies an index but contributes no signal' (all three eval methods); RegressorParitySuite 'per-event keeps HRFs aligned with events across a zero amplitude' and 'windowing out an onset does not re-bind per-event HRFs'.

Verified JVM+JS.
